question: What is the SI unit of time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Second**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The second **is the SI unit of the time period.
 
• The time period is defined as an interval after which periodic motion repeats itself.
 
• For eg, The time period of a simple pendulum, Earth’s rotation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Terms**
 **Equal to**
 
 

 Minute
 60 Seconds
 
 

 Millisecond
 **10−³ **Seconds
 
 

 Hour
 3600 Seconds
